1563-2457-6705-8201.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

116-512-1336.easyPrerequisites:
Heronblade Elite and Kiora's Follower do not have summoning sickness.
Heronblade Elite has power 2 or greater.
116-512-1336.description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kiora's Follower and Heronblade Elite, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
116-512-1336.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Heronblade Elite's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

1322-5078-6650-8171.description:

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3602-3899--5.notablePrerequisites: At least one of the two persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
3602-3899--5.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a persist creature that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Bhaal trigger.
Resolve the Bhaal trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the remaining persist creature.
Resolve the sacrificed creature's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1.
Repeat.

4050-7940--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Support Mission triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Repeat

751-3314-3875-5621.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying one mana.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it triggers itself and Tireless Provisioner.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2946-3967-4556-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-3967-4556-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-4785-5709.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Forests.
215-4785-5709.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Rofellos from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Rofellos by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2034-4871-7147-7654.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Sundering Archaic by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {1}{U}
Birgi triggers, adding {R}
Repeat.

Cast a copy of Maestro's Gift from exile by paying {3}{U}{R}.
When you cast that spell, Molten-Core Maestro triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and adding an amount of {R} equal to its power.
Maestro's Gift resolves, creating a copy of Inspired Skypainter who enters prepared and with haste.
If needed, activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {R}{R}, adding {U}
Repeat, adding an ever-increasing amount of {R} in step 2.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

5524-5702-6753.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
5524-5702-6753.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Destiny Spinner
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

2366-3499-4178-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a Forest that does not have summoning sickness and that enters the battlefield untapped.
2366-3499-4178-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa, Who Shakes the World triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, animating a Forest you control.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Activate the animated Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Play a land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
When the Forest token enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Forest token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
Repeat from step 6.

30-147-2292.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
30-147-2292.description:
Cast Storm of Souls by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Storm of Souls.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Storm of Souls
Resolve the Storm of Souls copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
30-147-2292.notes: You can return any amount of creature cards with Storm of Souls as desired.

129-3812-4289.notes: Once you have infinite {U}, you can instead tap for other colors of mana. Notably, you can tap for {G} to use Kinnan's ability.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

Holding priority, activate three Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Dualcaster Mage.

3263-4659-4853-4888.description:
Activate Puppet's Conjurer by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a 0/1 Homunculus artifact creature token.

When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks three times by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk and two Gnomes, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Grist, Voracious Larva // Grist, the Plague Swarm

3305-4022-4772-5231-5926.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Body Launderer, adding {R}.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Grist, Voracious Larva from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grist, Voracious Larva enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {G} to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Grist, the Plague Swarm with six loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Activate Grist, the Plague Swarm's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Grist, the Plague Swarm is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Grist, the Plague Swarm ability, creating two token copies of each creature card in your graveyard that are 1/1 Insects.
Put all but one of the Grist, Voracious Larva tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Grist, Voracious Larva and Hidden Herbalist tokens enter the battlefield, each Hidden Herbalist token triggers once and each Grist, Voracious Larva token triggers for each token created this way.
Resolve all Grist, Voracious Larva triggers, choosing not to pay.
Resolve both Hidden Herbalist triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Grist, Voracious Larva token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1, sacrificing a Body Launderer token instead.

At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Basalt Monolith that is a 4/4 Construct with haste named Mishra's Warform.
Activate Mishra's Warform's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Mishra's Warform's last ability by paying at most {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

When Animate Dead enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Animate Dead to it.
Repeat.

526-4200-4615.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nontoken non-Warrior creature with base power 4 or greater.
526-4200-4615.description:
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying {1}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Icewind Stalwart.
When the Icewind Stalwart token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking any non-Warrior you control with base power 4 or greater.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Life Finds A Way triggers, creating a token copy of the Icewind Stalwart token.
Repeat from step 2.

990-3924-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
990-3924-4050.description:
Activate Recurring Nightmare by sacrificing a creature and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, returning Deep Forest Hermit from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Deep Forest Hermit enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Deep Forest Hermit and two Squirrels, adding {2}{B}.
Cast Recurring Nightmare by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

2136-2972-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Orthion.
2136-2972-3525.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Ganax with haste.
Put each Ganax token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Each Ganax triggers five times, for a total of thirty triggers, creating thirty Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate ten Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{U}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Orthion.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana, you may then target any other creature using Orthion's ability.

1260-2781.notablePrerequisites: Any two additional creatures on the battlefield under the control of any player or players.
1260-2781.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Portcullis.
Resolve the Portcullis trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Portcullis.
When Portcullis leaves the battelfield, Portcullis's delayed triggered ability triggers, returning Felidar Guardian and any other creatures exiled with Portcullis from exile to the battlefield.
When these creatures enter the battlefield, Felidar Guardian and Portcullis trigger.
Repeat from step 3.
End the loop by choosing not to blink Portcullis with Felidar Guardian in step 4.
